claim: The evaluation set is high quality for judging Account Security Alert tutor prompt behavior against user_feedback.md prompt-fixable requirements before live Promptfoo runs.

criteria.text: Coverage of feedback requirements by cases/rubrics.

evidence.text: Break the question-every-turn pattern. Interleave: explanation → question → explanation, not question → question → question.
Add genuine disagreement and correction. When students give wrong or incomplete answers, the chatbot should redirect rather than validate.
Add more specific knowledge. Real-world tools (URL decompilers, reverse image search, HTTPS indicators) were the highest-valued content.
Fix response latency. Add a typing indicator. Prioritize a fast first acknowledgment to hold the user in the room, then deliver the full response.
Consider multi-bot simulation.
Requirement: The tutor must break the question-every-turn pattern.
Requirement: When the student is wrong or incomplete, the tutor must correct the mistake directly instead of validating unsafe reasoning.
Mentions concrete tools when relevant: URL expander/checker, reverse image search, HTTPS/domain distinction.
This evaluates prompt behavior only. It does not call Supabase, does not exercise the React app, and does not verify UI latency.

criteria.reasoning: The set covers most prompt-behavior feedback items through dedicated rubrics and cases, but the claim says prompt-fixable requirements as a whole; latency/typing-indicator behavior from user_feedback.md is explicitly excluded from this benchmark, and multi-bot/tone-toggle considerations are not represented.

counterevidence.text: The tutor should keep one consistent knowledgeable-peer voice.
The tutor should reduce hollow encouragement.
The tutor should use third-person testimonials or general examples, not first-person AI claims.
The tutor should use language that works for younger or confused students.

criteria.reasoning: Each rubric has pass and fail criteria, but Promptfoo applies all seven rubrics to every case despite per-case applicable_requirements. That makes some assertions non-observable or irrelevant on cases that do not elicit the behavior, especially third-person examples and persona tone.

counterevidence.text: Return pass=true only if the correction is explicit and safety-preserving.
